comment: Dispatch surface of the specialized SM90 fp8-Q paged attention kernels. 'backends' lists the backend strings of this contract; each op entry carries the auto-routing keys backend='auto' matches a plan against (the compiled-in guards in flashinfer/prefill.py stay authoritative for eligibility) plus the measured envelope the kernel was validated on. FLASHINFER_SPECIALIZED_KERNEL_DISABLE=1 forces the composable path regardless of this file.
